lines.zh: 我的脚步一变重，风就慢了
lines.en: When my steps grow heavy, the wind slows.

lines.zh: 强化之后，每走一步都在发热
lines.en: Empowered, every step runs hot.
I drop from the air and lift again.

lines.zh: 三米半的身体掠过树顶
lines.en: My three-and-a-half-meter body skims the treetops.

lines.zh: 拳头上还留着气，边走边散
lines.en: Ki lingers on my fist, bleeding off as I walk.
I lift a foot and the grass is scorched.
My trail carries a dark red glow.

lines.zh: 我走的是最短的那条直线
lines.en: I walk the shortest straight line.

lines.zh: 地形挡路，我就把它踩平
lines.en: Terrain blocks me, so I tread it flat.

lines.zh: 残影在我身后拖了半步
lines.en: An afterimage trails half a step behind.

lines.zh: 我伸手拨开一根横倒的树
lines.en: I push a fallen tree aside with one hand.

lines.zh: 暗红的气拖在身后，沟被跨过。
lines.en: Dark red ki trails behind me as I cross the ditch.
I hang midair, my chest rising and falling.

lines.zh: 变身后的气比之前更沉
lines.en: My ki sits heavier than before.
My fist stays closed.
Wind breaks apart before it reaches me.

lines.zh: 我在感受这副身体的力气
lines.en: I am feeling out this body's strength.

lines.zh: 暗红的光从我肩缝里漏出
lines.en: Dark red light leaks from my shoulder seams.
I look at the sky and say nothing.
Something crawls beneath my skin.
I breathe slow and my ki shivers with it.
I stare at the back of my own hand.
I spread my fingers, then draw them back.
My shadow glows red on the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，沙从脚背落下
lines.en: I lift a foot and sand spills off it.
I am waiting for the power to settle.

lines.zh: 我低头，暗红的眼睛对着你
lines.en: I lower my head, dark red eyes on you.

lines.zh: 你看到了不该看的样子
lines.en: You have seen what you should not.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，连自己都不熟
lines.en: Even I am not used to this shape.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我往前一寸
lines.en: You step back; I close an inch.

lines.zh: 你的手在摸武器，我记得这动作
lines.en: Your hand seeks a weapon; I know that motion.
You could still run, if you hurry.

lines.zh: 我的气把周围的草压倒
lines.en: My aura presses the grass down.

lines.zh: 我不需要喊，你看我一眼就懂
lines.en: I need not shout; one look tells you.
I tilt my head.
Your eyes are open too wide.

lines.zh: 我一低头，气就扑到你脸上
lines.en: I lower my head and my aura hits your face.
There is no path behind you.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，故意放松
lines.en: I put my hands behind my back, feigning ease.
You say nothing; so do I.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼皮看了你很久
lines.en: I keep my eyes on you a long while.

lines.zh: 你这点气，我一根手指就够
lines.en: One finger is enough for your kind of ki.

lines.zh: 我要看看你敢不敢先动
lines.en: I want to see whether you dare move first.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来，光亮了一下
lines.en: I turn my palm over and the light pulses.
A crack has opened in my armor.
The bar above me shifts.
I grit my teeth and my aura wavers.
That one cost me half a step.
The dark red light dims for a breath.
I close my fist again.
There is iron in my throat.
I glance down at the wound.
Heat escapes through the wound.
I brace a hand on the ground.
Empowered, I am hungrier; that is a problem.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，塞不满我
lines.en: What you hold could not fill me.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅，味道还算能吃
lines.en: I sniff; it is passable.
Do not hold it there; toss it.

lines.zh: 气在我胃里烧，吃什么都化
lines.en: Ki burns in my belly; all food dissolves.

lines.zh: 我伸手，掌心在你头顶停住
lines.en: I reach out, palm stopping over your head.

lines.zh: 这一口吃不吃，我还没想好
lines.en: I have not decided whether to eat.
You are as tense as a rabbit.
I look, then pull my hand back.

lines.zh: 这点香气散在风里就没了
lines.en: That scent is lost in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的身体撞过来，热得像炉
lines.en: My body strikes like a furnace.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸甲上，被烫了一下
lines.en: You hit my breastplate and recoil from the heat.

lines.zh: 我的护腕一横，你撞在上面。
lines.en: I raise my bracer and you slam into it.

lines.zh: 两股力撞在一起，气外溢
lines.en: Two forces meet and ki spills out.

lines.zh: 地面被我们踩出两道沟
lines.en: Our feet cut two furrows in the earth.
After the impact I barely sway.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你从我肩边滑过
lines.en: I turn and you slide off my shoulder.
I lay a hand on your back.
My knee pushes you off.

lines.zh: 我们撞碎了脚边的木板
lines.en: We smash the boards under our feet.
Even this body has someone who knows it.
She looks at me without flinching.
We hover high up without speaking.

lines.zh: 她替我把肩甲按压回去
lines.en: She presses my shoulder plate back into place.
My aura is hot, and she does not flinch.

lines.zh: 我们约好，谁先失控谁收手
lines.en: We agree: whoever loses control first stops.

lines.zh: 她把额头贴在我的角上
lines.en: She presses her brow to my horn.
We say nothing we do not need.

lines.zh: 她的气把我的热气分走一半
lines.en: Her ki draws half my heat away.
I set my hand on her shoulder.
I land and the ground jolts.
I bend and pick the thing up.
Heat passes from my fingers into it.

lines.zh: 我把东西收进胸甲内侧
lines.en: I tuck it inside my breastplate.

lines.zh: 地上的兵器，我一根根捡
lines.en: I gather the weapons off the ground.
One squeeze and it melts.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚焦黑的坚果
lines.en: I pick up a charred nut.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的矛头拔出来
lines.en: I pull a broken spearhead free.
I press it into my belt.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着的东西，我挖了出来
lines.en: I dig out what was buried in the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，暗红的光亮了
lines.en: I raise my head and the dark red light kindles.
My eyes ring you in.

lines.zh: 你刚进我的气圈，就晚了。
lines.en: You have barely entered my ki field, and it is already too late.
I raise my hand; a knuckle pops.
The strength inside pushes outward.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正好是正前方
lines.en: You stand exactly dead ahead.

lines.zh: 我不算距离，我一步就到
lines.en: I do not measure; one stride is enough.
The afterimage has already moved.

lines.zh: 你听见风了吗，那就是我
lines.en: Do you hear that wind? That is me.
I push my hand forward.

lines.zh: 残影从三个方向同时动
lines.en: Afterimages move from three directions.
You can only track one.
My aura pins your feet.

lines.zh: 我压低声音，念了句什么
lines.en: I lower my voice and mutter something.
A dark red ring glows on the ground.
You raise your weapon too slowly.
My afterimage is on your left.

lines.zh: 你转头找我的时候，我在右
lines.en: When you turn to find me, I am right.

lines.zh: 暗红的光把沙照得发黑
lines.en: The dark red light stains the sand black.
I do not stop; my speed is still climbing.

lines.zh: 残影一个接一个留在地上
lines.en: Afterimage after afterimage stays behind.
What you cut is air.

lines.zh: 残影还没散，我已经换位。
lines.en: My afterimage has not faded and I have already moved.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，气就压在头上
lines.en: One lift of my hand presses ki on your head.
You back into a crevice; it is too narrow.
I look down from above.
However fast you are, you are a beat slow.
An afterimage slips behind you.

lines.zh: 三米半高，一步就够到你。
lines.en: Three and a half meters tall — one step reaches you.
I step on your shadow.
When I strike, the wind scatters.
Your eyes cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 我压低身形，贴着地面走。
lines.en: I drop low and skim the ground.
You look back; I am already at your side.

lines.zh: 我一拳挥出，空气被撕开
lines.en: My fist tears the air open.

lines.zh: 掌心的小气弹射了出去
lines.en: A small ki blast snaps from my palm.
My knee drives into your chest.

lines.zh: 这一下带着变身后的重量
lines.en: This blow carries my empowered weight.
You block with an arm and give three steps.
I follow with an elbow.

lines.zh: 气功波把地面犁出一道沟
lines.en: The ki wave ploughs a furrow in the ground.

lines.zh: 我抓你，指尖擦过你的衣
lines.en: I grab; my fingertips graze your clothes.

lines.zh: 你躲开了第一击，躲不开第二
lines.en: You dodge the first, not the second.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，气成扇形
lines.en: I thrust a palm and ki fans out.
My fist cracks beside your ear.
I sweep a leg at the back of your knee.
My shoulder knocks you off your feet.
I catch your weapon in my hand.
I add a kick and send you away.
My knuckles are slightly scraped.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音传了很远
lines.en: The sound of my landing carries far.
Dark red aura coils around the ground first.
I stand, shoulders broader than a tree.

lines.zh: 变身的裂痕还在我身上
lines.en: The seams of the change still show on me.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看着自己的掌心
lines.en: I raise a hand and study my palm.
I exhale and the grass falls outward.
My blood runs hot beneath the skin.
I hear someone shouting far away.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起，看向那片天
lines.en: I lift my head to that sky.
I speak, and the voice has changed.

lines.zh: 暗红的光从脚下一路铺开
lines.en: Dark red light spreads from my feet.
I rotate my shoulders and the armor answers.
Cracks still run along my horns.
I drive my fist into the ground.
The ground splits a finger's width.

lines.zh: 热浪把我脚边的草吹倒
lines.en: Heat flattens the grass by my feet.
I settle down slowly.
I raise my head and look to the field's edge.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，我反倒吸了口气
lines.en: Fire burns on me and I draw it in.
I hit the ground and dig a deep crater.
Water presses in and the heat is smothered.
The blast lifts me off the ground.
An arrow pierces my shoulder.

lines.zh: 咒力压住我的气，很难受
lines.en: Magic pins my ki; it is unpleasant.
Empty-bellied, even the fire burns low.

lines.zh: 雷落在我的角上，通到脚底
lines.en: Lightning hits my horns and runs to my soles.
The ground is gone; I fall and fall.
